html_glossary_cleanup_hint: The interval counts distinct chapters with successful term extraction. When enabled, the selected model runs in the background to remove ordinary words and merge alternate spellings of the same person or place. This incurs additional API charges. Less capable models may remove terms incorrectly; a more capable model is recommended. The previous glossary is retained so you can undo the most recent cleanup.

html_model_access_description: Translation and polishing can use different models, selected under Advanced. Each provider has its own saved API key, shared when translation and polishing use that provider. API keys stay in this device's extension storage and are used only by the extension's background process to contact the corresponding service.
html_model_behavior_description: Choose a provider, then one of its models. Translation and polishing can have separate models and reasoning effort levels. Changes apply to subsequent requests. Leave polishing unselected to use the translation model.

html_novel_support_note: Light novel mode supports ncode.syosetu.com (Shosetsuka ni Naro) and kakuyomu.jp (Kakuyomu), automatically detecting chapters and next-chapter links. Once three distinct chapters of a work have been recorded, the extension attempts term extraction after chapter translation. Successful extraction creates a local glossary. Only these sites are currently supported.
